name: Bandung
blurb: Online conversation regarding Bandung is currently quiet, with transport discussions highlighting connectivity via the Jakarta-Bandung high-speed railway and local transit. Visitors also share experiences featuring local cuisine, scenic nature spots, and handmade goods.

positive: Appreciation for local food and handmade boots
Praise for scenic nature and mild weather
